data.verdict: Scope-(a) NEGATIVE (no fit): the q-Borel–Laplace resummation of the q-Gevrey binding statistic Z_n(q0) ~ q0^(n^2), with the level-1/2 q-Borel kernel t_n=q0^(n^2) (the q-lift of the classical Gevrey-1/2 moment Gamma(n/2+1)) and a positive theta measure carrying t_n as an exact q-moment (Jackson/Zhang q-Laplace), evaluated parameter-free at the substrate coupling gives m_e·f <= 0.06107 MeV (<= 2.75% of B_D=2.2245), undershooting by ~36x. The value is robust in N, Pade order, theta cutoff and the period convention (Z_n/n 2.75%, Z_n 3.24%); the Stokes/alien jump at the substrate is ~0.007 MeV (negligible). f reaches B_D only at x~1.12, beyond the Borel radius 0.9552 (through the singularity) — not a substrate quantity, so a match would require tuning the coupling (a fit). This CORRECTS the transform used by the prior negative-closure probe (classical Gamma-Borel on the q=1 telephone period) and confirms its conclusion was robust: the correct q-Borel–Laplace on the correct q-Gevrey object does NOT close the deuteron wall parameter-free. Distinct-mechanism (q-rotational mu0·hbar_q·J_q^2) route indicated. No fit; no wiring; no tier change; EXPLORATORY.
